title: SQL injection via a JSON array for year/isbn (charlist bypasses quote-escaping)
evidence: lib/book_api/store.ex:80 `defp q(value), do: to_string(value)` — only binaries are escaped (store.ex:79); nullable/1 (store.ex:83) routes year/isbn through q/1. Router validate/1 (router.ex:51-55) checks only title/author, so {"year": [49,41,59,32,68,82,79,80,...]} decodes to an integer list, to_string/1 turns it into the raw text `1); DROP TABLE books; --` (verified: `elixir -e` prints it unescaped) and it is spliced into the INSERT at store.ex:31, which the sqlite3 CLI runs as multiple statements.
suggestion: Validate year is an integer and isbn a string in the router; make q/1 reject non-scalars; better, use parameterized queries (Exqlite) instead of shelling SQL text to sqlite3.

title: Non-scalar year/isbn (e.g. {}) crashes the Store GenServer instead of returning 400/422
evidence: lib/book_api/store.ex:80 to_string(%{}) raises Protocol.UndefinedError inside handle_call; the connection process (server.ex:16) dies with no HTTP response
suggestion: Type-check optional fields in Router.validate/1 and return 422.

title: Malformed or oversized requests crash the handler instead of returning 400
evidence: lib/book_api/server.ex:28-31 — read_request errors such as {:error, :too_large} or {:error, :timeout} match the `{status, body}` clause, so send_response(client, :error, :too_large) calls IO.iodata_to_binary(:too_large) (server.ex:116) and raises; the 400 fallback at server.ex:32 is unreachable. A non-numeric Content-Length also raises at server.ex:54.
suggestion: Match {:error, _} explicitly before {status, body} when status is an integer.

title: UPDATE/DELETE/schema statements ignore sqlite3 exit status
evidence: lib/book_api/store.ex:61-62 sql/2 discards the System.cmd result; query/2 (store.ex:65) instead crashes with MatchError on non-zero exit
suggestion: Check the exit status and surface a 500.

title: Tests call Router.dispatch directly and share the default on-disk DB
evidence: test/book_api_test.exs:5-47 never exercise the :gen_tcp server; application.ex:6 defaults to data/books.sqlite3, so tests write into the dev database
suggestion: Set DATABASE_PATH to a temp file in test_helper.exs and add one end-to-end HTTP test.

title: normalize/1 is a no-op
evidence: lib/book_api/store.ex:73-76 Map.update("year", nil, fn year -> year end)
suggestion: Remove it or give it a real job.

title: Missing title/author returns 422, not 400
evidence: lib/book_api/router.ex:9; REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify mentions 400, TASK.md only asks for validation
suggestion: None required; 422 is a defensible status.

title: Hand-rolled HTTP server, JSON codec and sqlite3 CLI shell-out instead of Plug/Jason/Exqlite
evidence: mix.exs deps: []; lib/book_api/server.ex, json.ex, store.ex:62; idiomatic=0.45 in scores.json
suggestion: Use Plug.Cowboy (or Bandit), Jason and Exqlite/Ecto.
